interpretation: The architecture test distinguishes RNA-recoverable shared state from RNA-unrecoverable privileged-private state.
Forcing equal-variance shared and private factors into one compulsory target substantially lowers attainable full-state recovery.
The smoke test supports using rotation-aware recoverable subspaces rather than requiring coordinate identity.
limitations: no real NIH-CARD or FULL104 values used
